🔥 editor | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a flexible and extensible platform for creating and editing 3D architectural models, with a focus on local-first operation and seamless integration with AI agents for enhanced workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source 3D architectural editor • Local-first architecture • Browser and CLI interface • React Three Fiber and WebGPU powered • AI agent integration via MCP
📖 Summary: Pascal Editor is an open-source, local-first 3D architectural editor that runs in the browser or via a CLI. It leverages React Three Fiber and WebGPU for its rendering capabilities and integrates with AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
